provenance.section: Heartbeats — "Each message carries a heartbeat_counter so clients can detect missed messages."
modifications: sequence_num changed from 0 to 1, so it follows the baseline heartbeat.
heartbeat_counter changed from 3049 to 3051, skipping 3050. The venue publishes this counter for exactly this purpose.
current_time advanced by two seconds, consistent with a one-per-second cadence and two elapsed heartbeats.

expectation: Parses. sequence_num is in order, so nothing is wrong at the connection level — and that is the point: heartbeat_counter detects loss during a period when no market-data message was expected. Emits a COINBASE_HEARTBEAT_GAP anomaly and a FeedGapDetected with requiresAuthoritativeSnapshot true.
